title: The Anticipation: Of Joy
speaker: St. Paul's UCC
description: Pastor Erica Roth delivered an inspiring message titled "The Anticipation: Of Joy," focusing on Philippians 4:4-7. We explored how true joy is rooted in a sense of God's wholeness and everything coming together for good, even amidst life's challenges. Pastor Erica encouraged us to transform our worries into prayers and to let Christ displace worry at the center of our lives.
